Money Vigilance looks responsible from the outside.

You track. You save. You don't spend carelessly. People probably see you as the sensible one.

But underneath that steadiness there is often a quiet freeze — a reluctance to commit capital, make a call, or move the number anywhere meaningful.

Not because you don't know what to do. Because looking directly at it feels like too much.

That is the thing worth turning toward.

If you want to do that work — not a course, not a framework, just an honest reckoning with where you actually are and what is actually in the way — I have coaching slots open.

[Book a conversation →](https://wayofwealth.co.uk/coaching)

Joel
